Koffee with Karan Season 9 Promo Features Salman Khan

The promo for the upcoming season of the talk show 'Koffee with Karan' has been released, featuring Bollywood actor Salman Khan. The promo hints at revelations regarding Khan, with host Karan Johar. The show is expected to be available on OTT platforms. The release date for the new season is noted as between October 12-18, 2026, with other titles like 'Roadies Rebirth' also mentioned as upcoming OTT releases on platforms including Netflix and JioCinema.
